name: opaque-xrpl-demo-dapp
description: An ordinary XRPL dapp, on xrpl-connect, that uses Opaque through its adapter: the X3 exit check's DEX trade, AMM deposit and NFT purchase.

scripts.deploy: VITE_WC_PROJECT=ac0ee6973644e277d619337f29593c61 vite build && npx --yes vercel@64.5.0 deploy dist --prod --yes --project opaque-xrpl-demo --scope swarnim-raj-s-projects

comment: A test fixture, kept out of frontend/ on purpose: xrpl-connect brings the
Xaman, GemWallet and Xyra SDKs, which the wallet must never bundle. Here
it is the dapp's dependency, as it would be on any real dapp.
